articles.summary: Following the successful Welcome Points trial, which recorded more than 31,000 visits at 37 railway stations across Great Britain, L.B. Foster has been appointed by the Rail Delivery Group (RDG) to deliver Welcome Point interactive devices for the nationwide rollout of Welcome Points across the national rail network. In a survey, 93% of customers said they were satisfied, while 99% of disabled customers reported a positive experience.
articles.title: inform by L.B. Foster Set to Transform Accessible Travel Across Britain's Rail Network
